title: REPORT on the reform of the European Electoral Act – hurdles to ratification and implementation in the Member States
part_text: ‘Recalls that Council Decision (EU, Euratom) 2018/994 contains a number of provisions that Member States are either obliged or invited to implement; points out that optional measures have not been implemented by some Member States and that some mandatory measures have been implemented differently by some Member States, such as those concerning the prevention of double voting; notes that most provisions laid down in Council Decision (EU, Euratom) 2018/994 remain optional;’ without the words ‘that optional measures have not been implemented by some Member States and’
